reviews.text: Dr. Susan Pasagic is very cold and rude. Dr maxwell is awesome, so if i need to return i will make sure she is not the vet caring for my dog.

Brought my bearded dragon in for checkup and fecal test. The nurses that came in before were so kind and supportive! Dr.Maxwell was amazing. He let me see the samples under a microscope and took the time to answer all of my questions. (And there were many about a lot of things). I will continue to bring my boy here. I felt safe and comfortable.

Wish I could give zero stars. First, greatly overcharged me for first visit despite telling them I had a rabbit. $100+ than what they quoted. Next, I brought in the rabbit stool sample. It's been 6 months, no word. I asked them to cut the animals nails. I was getting scratched upon getting home. Finally they even missed sexed the bunny. It's a boy. This place is absolutely useless. Avoid.

I felt very comfortable at this hospital. Dr Sue is just the most knowledgable vet I have ever taken my animals to! Everything that was explained to me in detail, and she could answer any questions without even hesitating. The techs are fantastic too. Ashley and Thomas were super careful with my dog, and I got results whilst I waited!
Highly recommend this hospital, and Dr Sue will be my pets forever vet.

Dr. Susan has horrible customer service and was incredibly rude. If she's your assigned vet, ask for someone else — Dr. Maxwell and the rest of the staff, by contrast, were great. Very kind and professional.

On 7/13 my cat had bloodwork and a rabies vaccine. Staff said they'd call the next day with results — they never did. Turns out they'd entered my phone number wrong, so a week went by with no contact, even though I'd already flown family in for her post-surgery care based on the timeline I was given.

I'd also told them multiple times, in person, that surgery needed to be booked for 7/23. They booked it for 7/16 instead. When I brought this up, Dr. Susan told me it was my fault, that I'd no-showed, and that I hadn't answered calls/texts — the same calls and texts that never reached me because of their own data-entry error.

On top of that, the bloodwork had to be redone (~$300+) because of the clotting results. If they'd called when they said they would, I could've caught this a week earlier. I asked Dr. Susan to waive the repeat fee given the mix-up; she said "for what?" and blamed me again. Said “you could’ve called us.”

My cat is now sick and I'm having to find a new vet. Avoid this practice if you can — and if you do go, avoid Dr. Susan.

First visit with Grace and Duane Maxwell, DVM.  I brought my rescue poodle “Toulouse”  in and they were so kind and helpful to both of us.  I was so impressed with everything they did to make us feel welcome and get him on a healthier path.

Dr. Susan and her vet tech Thomas were AMAZING with my little Bear Bear! Other clinics in this area don't hold a candle to these two, and I mean it. I've tried other places, but either the vet or staff were standoffish and brusque for no reason. Thomas really went above and beyond, and was exceptionally courteous with my family in our hour of need. He really made an effort to ensure my dog was calm and cared for through the whole process. I wouldn't entrust her care with anyone else.

I came into the establishment to ask some questions, and was not even greeted, the 2 lady’s didn’t even bother to acknowledge me it was a girl with long straight hair and glasses, the other had curly hair and color in her hair. How unwelcoming. They were assisting someone, however you could have just acknowledged me and told me to give you a second
It was a little pricey but I wanted to make sure my pup was in capable hands.

Dr Susan was awesome! She really knew how to take care of our turtle. When we brought our turtle in, he was not doing well at all… Possibly only had days left. Once we met the doctor, she told us what we needed to do, and now our turtle is healthy and back to his old self. We cannot express enough, how much their knowledge and care meant to us and our pet. We completely recommend North Tollway Pet Hospital and all of their doctors and associates for any pet care needs.
A great deal on an office visit fee, very nice staff and they took good care of my dog.  Would highly recommend.

I’ve been taking my dogs here since 2019. They recently got a new front desk/ customer service individual and wow she is not nice. Every interaction I have had with her she has been miserable. I feel terrible for the younger front desk gal that has to work side by side with her because I’ve also seen how she treats her and it’s just unacceptable. She needs some coaching before you start losing employees and patients. What a shame because the doctor is one of the best!!

I very much appreciate how well North Tollway Pet Hospital takes care of my puppy (well he's actually five!).  They are always responsive and thorough. I am particularly fond of Dr. Maxwell who is very calming and gifted. Anyone can see how much he loves our pets!

So pleased. This is definitely my new Vet. Everything about the staff and  Dr Maxwell is divine. Felt super seen and my dog loved being there. Dr Maxwell was just awesome. Cost was reasonable. Highly recommend.
Just want to thank you for doing such a wonderful job like cash keep up the good work the staff was very polite and professional kudos to everyone.

Thanks for the rating! We're here to provide the best quality care and expertise. If ever needed, we hope we can provide an even better experience on your next visit. We appreciate you taking the time to leave us a review!
Thank you for the wonderful rating! We certainly appreciate your trust. We're here to deliver quality veterinary care whenever you need us.

We have been going to this animal hospital for many years and had always loved our experience there. However, recently, we took our dog to get her vaccines, a wellness exam, and additional services (gland check and nail trim). The appointment was pushed back to the late afternoon from earlier in the morning due to an emergency the staff was dealing with. When we arrived, we informed the technician of the reason for the visit and our questions for the veterinarian. After an hour and a half, we were told by the receptionist that we can leave. However, at that point, our dog has only received the vaccines, and we still have not seen the veterinarian (exam required by law for the vaccine) nor has our dog received the gland check or nail trim. We requested to speak with the veterinarian and were finally after able to speak with them after 2 hours. We were told that they were still dealing with an ongoing emergency. We completely understand that unexpected situations might arise, but we would have preferred to come back on a different date. Instead, we felt that our dog was not well cared for. This clearly demonstrated an issue with the lack of communication between the members of their team (front desk, technicians, supervising veterinarian) and with the pet owners and did not positively reflect on their dedication to care for all patients.

I have never felt such kindness from a clinic as I have from these people. Twice I have had to unexpectedly bring in a pet to have them be put to sleep, and neither time have I felt judged or forced into a decision I didnt want to make. These people truly love their work, and the pets that come in.

The Dr’s and staff are very caring and helpful!  There was one hiccup on the day of surgery when our ferret’s implant failed to come in, but they managed to get one same day. This was extremely appreciated since the clinic is a hour drive from our home. They took great care of our ferret during her tumor removal and implant placement surgery and she is recovering quickly.

We appreciated the care of our ferrets so much at this office that we are now bringing our 2 German Shepherds here to see Dr Maxwell. The care and attention they receive is amazing!
Thomas and Lena are awesome. Office has friendly and great quality service
Dr. Maxwell and his staff are unfailingly polite and professional. Knowledgeable and inspire confidence.

Outstanding customer service
Grooming -Phyllis
Dr Maxwell is the best Vet

Dr. Susan Pasagic is the cat whisperer. She is very loving and gentle with the animals, and very knowledgeable and helpful, we will definitely continue coming here. Also all of the vet techs we worked with were extremely friendly and helpful! Highly recommend coming here

My Freddie (cat) had his dental done here and the staff were amazing and very friendly. They gave me a call when he woke up from surgery. The vets, both Dr. Pesagic and Dr. Maxwell were so lovely and personable. If any extractions were to take place they discussed everything and broke costs down. I was really impressed with this vet clinic and will be bringing my Freddie back, as well as my other felines when they need their dentals or other vet care! Highly recommend!
Thank you for the wonderful rating! We take a lot of pride in delivering the best care and are glad you had a great experience with us.
Thank you for loving and caring for my furs…all three of them!

First-time visitor to North Tollway Pet Hospital, bringing my cat. The office Staff and Dr. were GREAT. Handled my cat with care and was in and out in no time. I was also able to receive 1st time customer discount. The doctor and staff  cared about the health and well-being of my 🐈  I will definitely keep coming back.

I came here after learning my big chain vet was unable to treat or even diagnose what I have now learned is a severe spinal injury in my 95 pound lab. Dr. Pasagic took the time to learn all of the details, thoroughly examine my dog, and provide a range of treatment options.  Her process and diagnosis confirmed to me that she is an extremely qualified and experienced veterinarian.  I came away feeling very confident that she knows exactly what she is doing.  My previous vet was completely lost.  I will be pulling my dogs from my chain vet immediately, and I will be recommending the same for my friends and family.

Clean facility, no weird pet smells or pet hair everywhere. Staff were super friendly and nice. I loved how they made my nervous 12 year old dog feel comfortable and relaxed. He gets super nervous and was visibly trembling when we first got there, but by the time we left he was wagging his tail and walking with a bounce. I loved how they were thorough and explained future procedures. I was even given a quote for future services so there wouldn’t be any “surprises” when it comes to the cost.

As a hamster owner, I didn’t realize how limited there were of veterinarians in the area with that specialty. So my son and I were thankful that we were able to get an appointment so quickly to help assist with his hamster knocking his teeth out.

I just waited an hour for an appointment that i had to reschedule. They seem to be very selective on who they give their attention. Going through with the rescheduled appointment then finding a new vet that actually cares about everyone equally.

the vet was so rude and patronizing for no reason lmfao i’m so confused. she also said she’s concerned about my 2 month, almost 3 months kitten bc he’s skinny so he might have FELV- which i understand is a concern , but he’s a rescue and if she looked at his paperwork she would see he had worms just last month and got dewormed, which can explain the thinness. i’m going to get him tested bc i need to anyways as he’s a new kitty. but yep, not good vibes, wouldn’t recommend and def not going there again lol.also i overheard her speaking trash about me bc i said i was worried he was eating too quickly so i didn’t give him seconds of wet food 😂😂😭 idk what’s wrong w that vet
Thank you for the wonderful rating! We take a lot of pride in delivering the best care and are glad you had a great experience with us.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
I can’t say enough good things about this place. Dr Roswell  was absolutely amazing — so knowledgeable, kind, and gentle with my dog. You can tell he truly cares about his patients and takes the time to explain everything clearly. The technician was wonderful too —friendly ,patient, caring, and made sure my dog felt comfortable the whole time. And the receptionist was so friendly and welcoming, making check-in and payment easy and stress-free.

Thank you to the entire team for treating Hershey like a  family. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for excellent, compassionate care! 🐾❤️
I really love how kind and thoughtful the staff is and the wonderful care they provide for my cat Dillon. Thank you very much. 😻

I brought my bearded dragon Charlie in for some concerts of a respiratory infection. The vets were very kind and took all my concerns into consideration. They explained everything they were doing in detail and made sure I left with no questions. Highly recommend bringing your exotic pets here!
Clean area, staff and doctors give excellent service
The team at North Tollway is kind, courteous, and professional. Thank you for all you do!
Super informative, helpful and kind! I felt very welcomed!

I went in with a friend yesterday, she took her cat in. The new vet they have is wonderful. She was so kind and the cats loved her. I was shocked with the old lady they had out front. so rude, not just rude to us but to the other poor girl working there with her. TBH she maybe looked kinda high or somethin, but either way not a good look.
dont think i will take my animals here, i just didnt like the vibe out front. But my friend was super happy with the vet care.

They were able to get both my cats in short notice and treated my fur babies with love. They listened to my concerns and were thorough in their examination. The drive there was the most stressful part of their vet appt. They were sensitive to my financial constraints and were upfront about costs and alternate options. Best vet I’ve ever been to- worth the 45 minute drive in traffic yesterday.
Phyllis my groomer is the best.

I have been coming here for over 8 years for my dog and the service has gone downhill while the prices have dramatically increased.  There is nothing that draws me to coming back here over choosing a random vet anymore.  Grooming has gotten very expensive and doesn't include nail trims and routine office visits cost more than a human doctor.

Thank you so much for your attention and patience in ensuring my kitten Grey receives all her vaccinations and deworming, and she even has a date scheduled for her spaying. I'm so happy to have a suitable place to optimize her quality of life. She's a kitten rescued from certain death, as her mother froze to death last winter, leaving her all alone.
I took my cat in for her annual visit.  I was very impressed with the team.  They treated Missy with the gentle care that I expected.  I'm very happy to have North Tollway Pet Hospital in our corner!
Appointment was on time and Dr. Maxwell is caring, competent and  just great.
completely awsome

Very happy with the care received on our 1st visit with Tito, our 15 year old chihuahua. The lady vet was very kind and her diagnosis was spot on. Unfortunately, we had to return 2 days later to say our final goodbye to our baby. The lead vet (my assumption), a very tall man, explained the process and had a very calm, caring way about him. The tech, who we had both visits, was wonderful, caring and sweet. These people are SAINTS!
personally heard the “vet” trash her employees.. broke hipaa and was telling all of her staff’s business to another person.. very unprofessional..
Thank you for the wonderful rating! We certainly appreciate your trust. We're here to deliver quality veterinary care whenever you need us.

Dr. Maxwell and his staff are wonderful. Very caring and everyone on his staff is so friendly. Dr. Maxwell is very caring with the pets and takes the time to thoroughly answer any questions thrown his way.

I found out the day of my international flight that they did not give my dog the bordatella vaccine at his last visit even though he was due. On the day of my flight I had to scramble to find another boarding option. They also did not keep a record of the prescription they wrote for my cat. Poor record keeping, I feel like keeping track of annual vaccinations is the most important part of the annual visit

I’ve been bringing my dog to Max’s Vet for the past 6 years, and I couldn’t be happier with the care we’ve received. Dr. Maxwell and the entire staff are incredibly friendly, professional, and compassionate. They truly care about the animals and it shows. The clinic is always clean, well organized, and never has that typical “vet office” smell, which I really appreciate. On top of that, their services are affordable and transparent. I completely trust them with my dog’s health and highly recommend them to any pet owner!
Dr. Duane Maxwell is the best!
Dr Maxwell was great at getting my doggie fixed up from his stomach issues :)
Everyone was professional, knowledgeable, and very kind, to me and my furry friend.

Dr. Maxwell... I don't have words. The best vet we've ever had. My dog has been battling cancer for a long time and he made sure he was as comfortable as possible. He had surgery and Dr. Maxwell gave me his cell number so I could reach out if anything happened. He goes above and beyond. I couldn't recommend him more highly.
They always take good care of my pets

My hamster had an abscess and the vets recommended draining the abscess. After going back several times to get the abscessed drained the vet recommended a surgical procedure. The procedure was botched and left my hamster in a far worst condition then when he came in.

They were so rough with him that he lost his ear due to the trauma and infection from the surgery. Furthermore he lost total vision in one of his eye, again due to the trauma and force that was used during the procedure. How do I know this, because I had to take my hamster to another vet. (If you have a hamster take them to Dr. Rachel Siu, as she actually knows what she’s doing and looks beyond the dollar value of your pet)

This establishment is a sorry excuse for a place that caters to “exotics” when it’s clear that they only care about charging you more for exotic pets, repeated appointment, and procedures.

Moved to this area about 2 years ago... They took such sweet care of the stray cat I adopted when she needed to be spayed. Took my 11 year old dog for a check up, rabies booster and nails trimmed yesterday. The entire staff was awesome but hands down the best Vet! He held my  55lb dog dog very gently even though she is very dramatic when she gets her nails trimmed. The best cost for excellent care!
Phyllis is awesome! She did a fabulous job of taking care of my sweet Cleo who was extremely matted. She left a detailed voice message of how she did and I think she’s a star. Thanks Phyllis!

My rabbit is a patient, and he received good care during his visit.  Everything is clean.  All the staff are friendly and helpful.  We came back for his yearly and saw Dr. Maxwell.  I was really impressed with his care.  My Bunny was able to trust him right away and he was not scared at all.  Very good doctor.

people thatwork there  they know how to treat the customers.  very polite.  i would recomend them to every one.  if your pup has aproblem they know what to do.  they love animal  justas much a we do.  and that shows e  that i have taken my pet to the right place,  barara showell
Phyllis is an amazing groomer!!! She takes great care of my cockers!!!
This is a really good place. Doctors are very honest and friendly. Staff always have a smile and ready to help.
